name: bozzies/pull-quote
title: Pull quote
description: Astro's <PullQuote> component — a centered <figure class="pull-quote"> holding <blockquote class="pull-quote__quote"> plus optional <figcaption class="pull-quote__attr">, wrapped in a full-bleed <section class="section ground-purple"> with an optional notes music-backdrop. Verbatim from ~/boswell-poc/src/components/PullQuote.astro plus the wrapping section from sisters/index.astro, career-timeline.astro, and bio-resources.astro.
